1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any
   contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The bound is where the schema's deferral meets the model's invariant and the refusal of an invalid file; this check forces it to answer to both artifacts without re-deciding either. Its three edges span three cells — one prose parent (natural→natural), one specification parent (structured→natural) and one artifact parent (code→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
